scope: Read-only report-coverage research. No synthesis, placement, routing, current build input changes, private database decoding, or hash checking.

confirmed_documented_commands.max_paths: Positive integer; default 25. No maximum value documented in the parameter table.
confirmed_documented_commands.max_common_paths: Positive integer; default 1. CN table explicitly says same clock and same object constitute the same endpoint. Keep 1 for endpoint coverage; increase only for alternative paths into one endpoint.
confirmed_documented_commands.mod_ins: Reports timing paths related to specified design submodule instances. Candidate hierarchy must still exist after synthesis.
confirmed_documented_commands.wildcards: ? matches one character; * matches zero or more characters including across hierarchy.
confirmed_documented_commands.module_fmax: report_max_frequency -mod_ins {instance0 instance1}; based on worst synchronous timing path ending inside the module; not detailed endpoint coverage.

application_conditions: Put report_timing in an enabled SDC consumed by the next selected candidate. It is an SDC report command, not a directly callable gw_sh shell command.
Append the single report_timing command to the NEXT candidate own existing g2.sdc before freezing it; retain all original clock/CDC/exception commands in that same g2.sdc.

Do not add/enable report_only_setup5000.sdc as a second SDC. SUG940 p8 says the last added SDC takes effect by default; SUG100 p30 says only one same-type constraint/configuration file can be enabled and adding another disables the previous file.

Do not change place_option, route_option, timing_driven, route_maxfan, correct_hold_violation, clock periods, exceptions, netlist, or physical constraints for the purpose of increasing report coverage.
Do not modify or append a running/frozen candidate. This research did not do so.

Officially documented route is PNR producing reports; the current public gw_sh interface has no verified fixed-route/STA-only entry point. Thus no supported way was found to enlarge the already completed PNR35 report without a later PNR/report-generating flow.
This does not prove that Gowin has no private or vendor-supported standalone STA mechanism. No private database decoding was attempted.
Do not enable incremental PNR merely to obtain a report; it is a PNR strategy change, not a documented STA-only flow.
next_result_acceptance: Check the new .tr Report Command contains the requested max_paths and all requested filters rather than default 25.
Check Timing Constraints Report State is Actived for each report_timing command; inspect command/matching warnings.

Check actual path-table rows, negative-slack paths and unique (latch clock, endpoint object) coverage against the new run violated-endpoint total. 5000 exceeds PNR35 count 3781 but does not guarantee a changed candidate has fewer than 5000 violations.
For multiple simultaneous report_timing statements, check each requested Report Command and resulting section are present; coexistence/ordering was not runtime-tested here.
The new candidate route may differ; larger report count itself is not timing improvement or proof of 50MHz closure.
not_verified: No statement that parser accepts arbitrary huge max_paths values.
No runtime measurement of report-generation memory/time for 5000 paths.
No proof that several report_timing commands retain every report section in this exact build until inspected in a future result.

coverage_checker.negative_zero_handling: A printed minus sign is counted as a failed slack, including -0.000 after report rounding.
coverage_checker.input_safety: Opens only public .tr text. No EDA launch, project load, database read, hashes, or build-input mutation.

terminology: Increasing report_timing max_paths broadens the paths/endpoints printed for review; it does not expand the STA engine analysis itself.

multi_sdc_correction.reason: The earlier extra add_file recommendation was incorrect: it conflated adding files with simultaneous enabled constraints and missed the explicit note immediately below SUG940 section3.3.3.
multi_sdc_correction.confirmed_rule: Only one constraint/configuration file of the same type can be enabled. A newly added same-type file disables the previous one. For multiple added SDCs the last added takes effect by default.
multi_sdc_correction.failure_mode: Adding report-only SDC could deactivate the original g2.sdc and omit its clock/CDC/exception commands.
multi_sdc_correction.safe_default: Append the single report command to the next candidate existing private g2.sdc before freezing, preserving all previous commands in the same active file.
